minutes.headline: Committee agreed to pitch both building options together at special town meeting and set a Nov 10 public forum.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee reviewed the slide deck for the renovation presentation and heard a draft Select Board presentation on town building conditions and free cash funding for design. It planned a November 10 public forum and a ledger notice. The architect's rebuild numbers were not yet in. The only recorded vote was adjournment.

attendees.role: member, presenting for the select board

public_comment.topic: Chair invited public comment; no one spoke.
Second call for public comment; only a phone participant was present and nothing was said.

budget_items.what_was_said: Members agreed to show only the final construction cost, soft costs and total, and to match the total to the warrant article's funding amount.
A member warned against floating conjectured rebuild numbers. Another said an unofficial indication was that the architect was working with a lower figure.
The renovation estimate is said to include inflation through a construction time frame next summer.
Design and engineering is described as a share of total project cost, charged in stages with a decision point after design development.
Free cash was described as unspent taxes already collected, abnormally high this year; a placeholder project cost was used in the draft slides.
A member asked who pays if town hall or the TC Passios building is damaged; the answer was insurance, though coverage was uncertain.

decisions.decision: Keep renovation and rebuild material separate in the slides with a hard stop between them, using consistent naming.
Double slides from the earlier deck will be split into single slides.
Dave will circulate a draft; members reply only to Dave, who sends the deck to Michael Ray for the Nov 2 select board meeting.
Michael Ray will recommend a combined presentation to the select board and finance committee, and the committee will ask the moderator about combining at town meeting.
Public forum on Nov 10 at 7 pm; the committee meeting will be posted for 6:30; ledger notice to be placed.
Michael Ray will present at special town meeting.
Next meeting Nov 3 at 5:30 by Zoom; PACK to be contacted for broadcasting the forum.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed to keep renovation and rebuild material separate in the slides, with a hard stop between them.
The committee will recommend a combined presentation to the select board and finance committee, and will ask the moderator about combining the options at town meeting.
A public forum was set for Nov 10 at 7 pm, with a ledger notice to be placed; Michael Ray will present at special town meeting.
The architect's rebuild estimate had not arrived, and a member cautioned against floating conjectured rebuild numbers.
No votes were recorded other than adjournment; no one spoke in public comment.

why_it_matters: The renovation and rebuild options are headed to a special town meeting, and residents will be asked to vote on funding for them, with free cash named as the source for design work.
The rebuild estimate was still outstanding, so residents may see the two options compared before the architect's numbers have been presented in full.
